title: From recording unit to touring band
summary: After the records sold, requests for dance dates came in and managers, at first Phil Ponce, booked one-nighters.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Now how did the group develop from just a recording unit, to becoming a regular performing group? When did that happen? What brought it about?

Uh, you mean the large group? Well, after we did those -- did our dates, and the people liked them, and they'd be -- they were buying them, then had some people to write in about dance dates, you know, if we would do some, you know. Some one nights here, and then, you know. So the managers, they set them up.
Well, yes, for a while, Philip Ponse. Later on he got very ill there, and he passed. Then went on to other agents.
